decision: kept the sealed-task-field test as a guard but claimed no leak

decision: refused to migrate the two failing pilot tests and sent the worker back instead
why: the tests were right and the change was wrong: one asserted the real construction budget, the other asserted honest attribution of an absent arm

decision: resolved the per-arm versus per-domain construction budget from the contract and the existing test

result: one candidate per arm 0.85, per-domain violates the cap 0.91

decision: decided the domain an arm’s single candidate does not cover runs the incumbent with explicit attribution
why: a policy is scoped to one family, so one candidate covers one domain, and the alternative was overspending the cap or reusing bytes across families
result: chosen at 0.93 with 0.91 confidence, the highest confidence answer of the run

decision: drew the line between required bookkeeping and a false claim
why: recording an absent arm as incumbent with a reason naming the absence is required; presenting it as a successful revised arm is forbidden
